note: The capability types this server knows and the function classes of docs/plans/phase-6-administration.md, section Capabilities, each with its treatment, whether it has an effect in this server and the reason (ruling SY6 of leg 6-system). The types are those of the content fixture (testdata/export/fixture-content); the type ids of a real install are an owner point, so the classes carry none. A type not listed is unknown: a save that changes a type to it is refused, a stored one is kept (R6). internal/admin holds a Go copy, and a test fails when the two differ. GET /api/capabilities/support answers each type with supported equal to effect and this reason.

types.reason: The addresses in answers come from the address of each request; this server keeps no base address.
While enabled, its property role is the role that the realm DefaultRole gives every signed in user.
This server calls no outside service.

classes.reason: Stored; its effect is built and tested in phase 7.
